args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Seoul Hero future facility individual PNG artwork.
Primary request: ONE Seoul Hero facility illustration. a sparse OPEN 2:1 transparent state overlay consisting ONLY of three small ivory disinfectant nozzle heads on one narrow navy horizontal crossbar in the upper third, two short lime containment strips at the left and right upper corners, and wispy translucent vapor confined to the upper quarter. At least the bottom 70 percent and most central space remain empty transparent pixels. No booth, room, rear wall, floor, platform, large side pillars, enclosing frame or full-width panel; no architecture behind the nozzle heads. Match the chunky SD urban-fantasy environment language: bold clean outlines, simple painted materials, pale ivory and navy structure with restrained teal/purple/orange indicators. No characters, baked labels, logos, UI frames, buttons or floor shadows on equipment. Clearly separate major silhouettes and retain generous safe margins. Real transparent background and one isolated complete object.
Style: original crisp Korean mobile-game hand-painted raster art, strong readable silhouettes, clean navy outlines where appropriate, restrained cel shading and material highlights. Follow the specific subject palette in the brief. Create a new silhouette and object, with no copied reference subject.
Modern Seoul guild facility artwork. For rooms use orthographic FRONTAL SIDE CUTAWAY, approximately 2:1, consistent horizontal floor height, clear foreground floor for separately overlaid SD employees. No people, HUD, text, buttons or isometric room view. Equipment is a separate transparent cutout, exterior and state follow the supplied subject.
Composition: single subject fully inside canvas, centered with 8 percent safe padding. No contact sheet or multiple examples.
Background: actual transparent RGBA, no opaque backdrop, no fake checkerboard.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermark, UI chrome, labels or numbers. Preserve the requested anatomy and view.

This is a sparse transparent overlay of suspended nozzle heads and small strips only. Do not draw a room, rear wall, booth, floor, architecture, large support frame or any backdrop. Keep the bottom 70 percent entirely transparent.
